description: An enterprise collaboration platform for people and multi-agent teams, built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness. Shared projects, plugins and Skills, integrated messaging, and editable code, documents, presentations, design, websites and video.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: This repository owns iPolloWork plugins, services, clients and packaging. DSH is an
external, version-pinned dependency. Never edit `.upstream/dsh`, copy its Agent loop into this repository, or add product patches to the official runtime.

Run `npm run setup:build` for a fresh checkout. It verifies the official archive, installs its locked dependencies and creates ignored local resolution links. The exact revision and SHA-256 live in `integrations/runtime/upstream.json`. Upgrades change that pin deliberately, then run the product checks and real-client smoke before adoption.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
